mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, u.username AS author_name, p.is_pinned, p.tags, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM prompts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, u.username AS author_name, p.is_pinned, p.tags, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM prompts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.folder_id = #{folderId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, u.username AS author_name, p.is_pinned, p.tags, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM prompts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompts (folder_id, title, content, author_id, is_pinned, tags) VALUES (#{folderId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{isPinned}, #{tags})
mapper.update: UPDATE prompts SET folder_id = #{folderId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE prompts SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
